items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: I know Pete before I know Manuel.

ctx.x: Uptown? Uptown. Yeah. He told me his family's from Donalvilleville. His sister, that's what he told me too.

I don't remember, I don't remember that. His sister was a good friend of mine, Rosalie, she's dead now. Now I don't know the brother that's the priest, but I know Pete. I know Pete before I know Manuel. Pete was playing banjo with Clyde, with no, with the Brown Buddies band. And then he joined Clyde Coors band. And I come in there after Morgan. And then Pete Morgan came in, Eddie Morgan came in playing the band, the guitar with Clyde, after Pete. Yeah. And then I came after Eddie Morgan. But Pete Sales, you…
He painted in there. Some of your favorite, say, banjo players when you started banjo.
